programme.title: Drinking Buddies - Erwachsen werden ist schwer
programme.desc: Luke (Jake Johnson) und Kate (Olivia Wilde) arbeiten zusammen in einer Bier-Brauerei in Chicago, wo sie den Tag über Bier trinken und wie soll es auch anders sein, miteinander flirten

programme.title: Magnolien Aus Stahl (1989)
programme.desc: Sechs Diven der Kinoleinwand – Sally Field, Dolly Parton, Shirley MacLaine, Daryl Hannah, Olympia Dukakis und Julia Roberts – spielen Busenfreundinnen in dieser ausgelassenen und ans Herzen gehenden Geschichte über das Leben, die Liebe und Verluste in einer kleinen Gemeinde in Louisiana. Im Mittelpunkt steht Shelby Eatenton (Julia Roberts), frisch verheiratet und hocherfreut über ihre Schwangerschaft, obwohl die Geburt sie aufgrund ihrer Diabeteserkrankung das Leben kosten könnte. Verängstigt und wütend darüber, eventuell ihre einzige Tochter zu verlieren, wendet sich M'Lynn Eatenton (Sally Fields) an ihre vier besten Freundinnen, um sich bei ihnen die nötige Kraft zu holen und die Angst vor dem Tod wegzulachen, um zusammen mit Shelby das Wunder des neuen Lebens feiern zu können.

programme.title: Ich weiß, wer mich getötet hat
programme.desc: Aubrey Fleming ist eine clevere High-School-Schülerin mit viel versprechender Zukunft. Eines Nachts verschwindet sie plötzlich wie vom Erdboden. Zwei Wochen später wird sie schwer verletzt im Wald gefunden: sie war von einem brutalen Serienkiller entführt worden, konnte aber fliehen. Im Krankenhaus kann sie sich an nichts erinnern. Sie glaubt, sie sei die Stripperin Dakota Moss. Die Ärzte vermuten ein post-traumatisches Stress-Syndrom und versuchen, ihr Zeit zu geben. Doch Aubrey spürt, dass sie ohne den Killer das Rätsel um ihre Vergangenheit nicht lösen kann

programme.title: Shadow Man-Kurier Des Todes
programme.desc: Als verbrecherische Elemente innerhalb der C.I.A. ein gefährliches Virus aus den USA schmuggeln und den ehemaligen Nachrichtenoffizier Jack Foster (Steven Seagal) als Kurier einsetzen, ahnen sie nicht, welchen Zorn sie damit auf sich ziehen. Jack hat keine Ahnung von dem Plan, in den er unwissentlich verwickelt ist. Er nimmt seine Tochter nach Europa mit, wo sie von einem geheimnisvollen ausländischen Agenten entführt wird. Um sie zu retten und ihre Kidnapper zu finden, taucht Jack in die finstere Welt der internationalen Spionage ein, wo Feinde hinter jeder Ecke lauern und Freunde sich plötzlich gegen ihn wenden!

programme.title: Cold Comes The Night
programme.desc: Alice Eve als verzweifelte Mutter und Bryan Cranston als erblindender Gangster liefern sich in dem Thriller Cold Comes the Night einen erbitterten Kampf. Chloe müht sich redlich um ihre kleine Tochter Sophia und in ihrem Job als Motel-Besitzerin. Das Geschäft läuft schlecht, ein Konkurs wahrscheinlich. Als sie beim Reinigen eines Zimmers eine große Summe Geld entdeckt, bietet sich ihr die Chance auf ein neues Leben. Alice hadert mit sich, lässt das Geld aber an Ort und Stelle. Nicht so der Cop Billy, der sich dankbar des Geldes annimmt. Das ruft den alternden Gangster und Besitzer Topo auf den Plan, der Sophia kidnappt und Alice ein Ultimatum stellt: Entweder sie beschafft das Geld oder die Tochter muss sterben. Diese Bedrohung setzt bei Alice ungeahnte Facetten des Mutterinstinktes frei…

programme.title: Touchdown - Sein Ziel Ist Der Sieg
programme.desc: Der junge Rudy (Sean Astin), der in den frühen 60ern in einer großen katholischen Arbeiterfamilie in Joliet, Illinois aufwächst, kennt nur ein Ziel: Football zu spielen für die Fighting Irish of Notre Dame. Bei seiner untersetzten Statur, der nicht gerade athletischen Veranlagung und schlechten Noten im Sport machen ihm Vater (Ned Beatty), Lehrer, Trainer und selbst Freunde alles andere als Mut. Doch Rudys Herz ist größer als sein Verstand. Gegen den Rat des Vaters folgt er seinem Traum und setzt sich in den Bus nach South Bend. Dort beginnt für ihn ein Kampf gegen fast unüberwindliche Hindernisse. Ein gütiger Priester (Robert Prosky) und ein rauer, aber herzlicher Hausmeister (Charles S. Dutton) stehen ihm bei. Basierend auf einer wahren Geschichte, geht Rudy über das typische Sportgenre hinaus und erzählt von der Kraft der Entschlossenheit, die Berge versetzen kann.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: Der Bürgerkrieg ist vorbei und die Traven-Brüder kehren heim. Aber was Mac (Tom Selleck, Quigley Down Under) und Dal (Sam Elliott, Tombstone) bei ihrer Ankunft vorfinden , ist eine Stadt, die von konföderierten Rebellen verwüstet wurde, die sich weigern, sich zu ergeben. Ihrem Schwur treu, die Yankees bis zum bitteren Ende zu bekämpfen, haben die Guerillas die jüngeren Schwestern der Travens entführt – ebenso wie Dals Herzblatt Kate (Katharine Ross, Shenandoah) - und planen, sie an ein Bordell in Mexiko zu verkaufen, um Geld für Waffen und Munition aufzutreiben. Fest entschlossen, ihre Lieben zu retten, befreien Mac und Dal ihren Onkel Black Jack (Oscar-Preisträger Ben Johnson, Best Actor in a Supporting Role, The Last Picture Show, 1971) aus dem Gefängnis und ziehen in den Süden hinter der Grenze, wo sie einen Krieg beenden wollen, den sie schon für beendet hielten.

programme.title: Gloria
programme.desc: Gloria Swenson (Gena Rowland), ein ehemaliges Showgirl und Flintenweib, muss plötzlich die Verantwortung für den 7-jährigen Phil Dawn (John Adames in seinem Filmdebüt) übernehmen, als dessen Familie in einem Bandenkrieg getötet wird. Als mögliche Beute in einem tödlichen Katz-und-Maus-Spiel rennen die beiden um ihr Leben und sie wird dabei zu einem weiblichen Bogart der 1980er.

programme.title: Adventures of Baron Munchausen, The
programme.desc: John Neville und Eric Idle spielen die Hauptrollen in diesem visionären Meisterstück über die ausschweifenden Fantasien eines Abenteurers im 18. Jahrhundert.

programme.title: Gegen jede Chance
programme.desc: Korruption, Intrigen und Machtgier beherrschen das Leben, aus dem Jessie (Rachel Ward) ausbricht. Terry (Jeff Bridges) ein Ex-Footballspieler soll sie finden und zurückbringen. In Mexico treffen beide aufeinander - eine heiße leidenschaftliche Liebe entbrennt. Gehetzt von Terrys Auftraggebern fliehen sie bald nach Los Angeles zurück. Hier hält der betrügerische Anwalt Caxton (Richard Widmark) alle Fäden in der Hand. Terry findet Belastungsmaterial gegen Caxton und versucht ihn damit zu erpressen. Doch seine Rechnung scheint nicht aufzugehen.

Ben Campbell ist Mathematikstudent am renommierten MIT und ein wahres Genie auf seinem Gebiet. Eines Tages erhält er ein verlockendes Angebot: Der Mathematik-Professor Mickey Rosa will ihn für sein „Black Jack Team“ anheuern. In diesem Team bildet Rosa sechs hochbegabte Studenten als Spezialisten im Kartenzählen aus.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: Als an einem Flußufer die Leiche einer junge Frau aufgefunden wird, steht der Obdachlose Carl Anderson (Liam Neeson) unter Verdacht. Er soll die Sekretärin ermordet haben, nachdem ihr Chef - ein Richter - Selbstmord begangen hat. Für die Gerichtsverhandlung wird Anderson die Pflichtverteidigerin Kathleen Riley (Cher) bestellt, die von seiner Unschuld überzeugt ist. Zusammen mit dem Geschworenen Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid) versucht sie die Wahrheit herauszufinden. Eigentlich darf der Geschworene keinen Kontakt zur Anwältin aufnehmen, lässt ihr aber dennoch einen wichtigen Hinweis zukommen. Schon bald entpuppt sich der Fall als brisanter als vermutet: Die Spur des Mörders führt bis an die Spitze der Regierung...

programme.title: Genug - Jeder Hat Eine Grenze
programme.desc: Die Kellnerin Slim (Jennifer Lopez) muss hart für ihr Geld arbeiten. Da erscheint ihr der Bauunternehmer Mitch (Billy Campbell) wie ein Traum: Er ist liebenswert und wohlhabend. Die beiden heiraten, erwarten ein Baby und werden die perfekte Mittelklassefamilie. Doch das Glück bekommt Risse, verursacht durch den gewalttätigen Ehemann. Schließlich flieht Slim mit ihrem Kind an einen geheimen Ort. Bald allerdings entdeckt sie, dass sie überwacht wird. Slim sieht nur einen Ausweg: Sie trainiert besessen, um sich körperlich für eine Konfrontation mit Mitch fit zu machen. Und tatsächlich kommt es zum Kampf - einem Kampf auf Leben und Tod!

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Die Auftragskillerin Mary (Taraji P. Henson) arbeitet für die berüchtigtste Mafia-Familie in der Stadt, die von Benny (Danny Glover) geleitet wird. Als Mary einen geschützten Gangster erschießt, um einen kleinen Jungen zu retten, steht sie plötzlich mehreren Banden und Gangstern gegenüber, angefangen bei der russischen Mafia bis zu ihrem früheren Liebhaber. Mit geschärften Sinnen und einem Koffer voller Waffen muss Mary alles tun, um die Überlebende in diesem energiegeladenen und explosiven Action-Thriller zu sein.

programme.title: O Duelo Final
programme.desc: A vingança está no sangue! Uma lutadora aposentada volta à ativa quando a irmã é vítima de um criminoso dono de um clube clandestino de luta de rua entre mulheres.

programme.title: A Descoberta em Stonehenge
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de arqueólogos desenterra um esqueleto humano perto de Stonehenge, uma antiga máquina é descoberta. Os trabalhadores acidentalmente acionam o mecanismo e iniciam uma série de eventos que podem muito bem acabar com o mundo.

programme.title: Aterrissagem
programme.desc: Quando uma situação de refém surge em um avião particular com a filha de um bilionário a bordo, o major John Masters se junta ao capitão Williams para deter os terroristas e aterrar o avião.

programme.title: O Clã das Adagas 2
programme.desc: Na Dinastia Ming da China, Shen Lian, um polícia secreto do governo corrupto, está preso por conspiração em uma missão. Para provar a inocência, ele procura a verdade com uma garota chamada Bei Zhai.

programme.title: Renegados
programme.desc: Serena, uma jovem treinada como assassina de aluguel, se junta a um grupo renegado clandestino quando é contratada para impedir que um pistoleiro assassine um alvo importante.

programme.title: O Sequestro
programme.desc: Zara e Brian estão vivendo a vida perfeita em uma pequena cidade quando um misterioso estranho do passado secreto de Zara sequestra sua filha e agora eles devem fugir por suas vidas.

programme.title: Submissão
programme.desc: Dois marinhos voltam para casa depois de ter sido interrogados pelo ISIS e temtaram recuperar sua vida.

programme.title: O Inimaginável
programme.desc: A Suécia enfrenta um ataque misterioso enquanto Alex tenta se reunir com seu amor jovem, Anna.

programme.title: Inteligencia Artificial
programme.desc: Ederlezi Rising é um emocionante romance de ficção científica ambientado em um futuro próximo, sobre a missão espacial pioneira para Alpha Centauri realizada pela multinacional Ederlezi Corporation. A Ederlezi recruta Milutin, um cosmonauta eslavo treinado na recém-reformada União Soviética futurista, e o acompanha com Nimani, uma androide programada para satisfazer todos os seus desejos.

programme.desc: A Friend's Obsession

programme.title: Nao toque duas vezes
programme.desc: A escultora Jess tenta, sem sucesso, recuperar a guarda de sua filha adolescente, Chloe. Durante a noite, Chloe e seu namorado Danny fazem uma brincadeira desafiando uma lenda urbana: eles batem duas vezes na porta da bruxa Mary Aminov. Logo, Danny é perseguido por uma entidade maligna e desaparece. Quando Chloe começa a ser assombrada pelo espírito maligno, ela foge para a casa de sua mãe afastada, Jess, e do marido dela, Ben, para ficar com a mãe. Logo o demônio a encontra e passa a assombrar a casa enquanto Ben está viajando. A modelo de Jess, Tira, percebe uma escuridão ao redor de Chloe e começa a pesquisar na internet sobre o mistério. Enquanto isso, o detetive Boardman investiga o desaparecimento de Danny e suspeita que Jess está manipulando sua filha problemática.

programme.desc: A pedido de seu pai, o jovem D'Artagnan viaja do interior da Gasconha para Paris, onde se envolve em um enredo desonesto entre os mosqueteiros do rei e os guardas do Cardeal Richelieu.

programme.title: The Art Of Destruction
programme.desc: Founded in 1982, DESTRUCTION is a "Big Three" titan of German thrash alongside Kreator and Sodom. With uncompromising music and high-energy shows, they’ve thrilled millions. Discover the story of a global force that helped define the genre.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Flying V
programme.desc: Discover how the Flying V revolutionized Rock and Metal. Featuring icons from Metallica, Megadeth, Slayer, and Judas Priest, this documentary explores the history and secrets behind the world’s most unique guitar and the legends who play it.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Magic Lakes
programme.desc: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it’s far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2 lakes alone. Thanks to the Müritz National Park the species diversity is particularly high in the region: half of the German crane population breeds in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the osprey is typical of the Müritz area; the lively Eurasian otter hunts here; and the endangered red milan circles the skies above. Fred Bollmann knows the national park like hardly any other. The former ranger and voluntary nature conservationist is actively involved in the preservation of ‘his’ wildlife world. Filming for this production took two years. The outcome is a unique portrait of this stunning region.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Hoanib - The Secret of the Desert Elephants
programme.desc: The Namib, one of the most hostile deserts on Earth. Without a firm survival strategy, no living soul will make it here. Yet, surprisingly, some species have adapted their lifestyles to these extreme conditions: chameleons, beetles, snakes and mammals are all at home here. The film follows a family of desert elephants that has also adapted to this habitat.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hunters of the Skies
programme.desc: Birds of prey are symbols of power, speed and splendour. In fact, there are very few species in the animal kingdom that can be described in as many superlatives. Their amazing use of different senses, their incredible feats of flight as well as their multitude of different hunting strategies are simply astounding. Hawks, buzzards and eagles have conquered every habitat on earth - from the dry arid south, to the cool and moist river valleys, to the coasts of Norway, all the way up to the sparse high mountains. Some of them, like the incredibly versatile hawk, can even hunt in the forest. Their literal eagle eye vision is unrivaled in the animal kingdom. All birds of prey sustain themselves through hunting, and they do so elegantly and, it seems, with effortless beauty and efficiency. This is one of many reasons why they are much admired, even romanticised, by many cultures. Buckle up and join us on this aerial adventure with spectacular insights into this amazing world of birds of prey.

programme.title: mareTV: Hong Kong - Metropolis in the sea
programme.desc: Hong Kong translated means "fragrant harbour". The days of the spicy smoking ceremonies have passed, but MareTV has discovered many delightful contrasts between the metropolis and Mother Nature. In for-mer times, the rare eagle wood tree grew here. Its wood put the spice into the Taoist smoking ceremonies. The fragrant harbour: what sounds so charming is today a huge metropolis in the sea. No other tiny piece of land is more densely populated. Star Ferries have been commuting between the Kowloon Peninsula and central Hong Kong for the past 125 years. The British colonial masters are long gone, but on the ancient ferries, virtually nothing has changed. Most of the ships are still clad in British Racing Green and the crew still wears the old, decorative uniforms.

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein junger Medizinstudent glaubt, dass es einen Zusammenhang zwischen der Kopfform und der Intelligenz seiner Kommilitonen gibt und prägt damit die Neurowissenschaft. Als ein Chemiker im Zweiten Weltkrieg nach transparentem Kunststoff für Zielfernrohre forscht, entdeckt er nebenbei den Sekundenkleber. Und auch das Bier verdanken wir einer Reihe von Zufällen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Baumpfleger Steven Othold und seine Kollegen haben nicht nur einen der härtesten, sondern auch einen der gefährlichsten Jobs überhaupt. Denn die Seilkletterer müssen auf Bäume steigen und in der Baumkrone messerscharfe Sägen bedienen. Gut, dass er mit dem größten Fällkran Deutschlands einen starken Helfer zur Seite hat. Doch ein Baum zeigt sich heute besonders widerspenstig.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Torsten Becker arbeitet als Hufschmied. Während seiner Arbeit am Pferd muss Becker immer auf der Hut sein, denn wenn ihn das Pferd tritt, ist eine Verletzung garantiert. Prellungen, Knochenbrüche und Verbrennungen sind typische Unfallfolgen in dem Beruf. In einem Ofen werden die Eisen für die Hufe auf 1100 Grad erhitzt und dann auf dem Amboss in die richtige Form geschlagen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Jürgen Böhme und Andreas Arnold müssen sich beeilen. Ein Mobilfunkmast ist ausgefallen. Tausende Menschen müssen auf Internet und Telefon verzichten. Im schlimmsten Fall können in dem Gebiet auch keine Notrufe abgesetzt werden. Die Servicetechniker gehen auf Fehlersuche und klettern dafür den 35 Meter hohen Funkmast hoch. Auf sie muss Verlass sei – egal bei welchem Wetter.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In Altaussee in der Steiermark arbeiten 57 Menschen im Salzbergwerk und produzieren 450.000 Tonnen Natursalz im Jahr. Im sogenannten Trockenabbau kommen nur wenige Maschinen zum Einsatz, dafür ist umso mehr Muskelkraft gefragt. Tageslicht bekommen die Bergarbeiter dabei nicht zu sehen – und sie sind nicht die Einzigen, die in völliger Dunkelheit arbeiten.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse bekommt der T1-Oldie neue Safari-Fenster, während bei den Roller-Profis der Flying Classics heute eine Ausfahrt ansteht. Motor-Spezialist Michi von den Minis Hamburg setzt bei der Getriebereparatur nicht nur auf seine Erfahrung, sondern auch auf selbstgebautes Spezialwerkzeug. Luftgekühlt geht es bei den Maschinen der Porsche-Klassiker von Lundtauto in Berlin zu.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die frischlackierte Porsche-Karosse wartet bei Lundt in Berlin auf das Motorfinish, während Manni von den Minis Hamburg eine durchgerostete Tür wieder auf Vordermann bringt. Neue Achse und Bremsen, Edel-Felgen - Frischekur für den Bulli in Tom's Roadhouse. In der Roller-Werkstatt der Flying Classics ist heute Abschied angesagt: Die schwarze Vespa kehrt heim zu ihrem italienischen Besitzer.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Restaurierung des Porsche 911 ist abgeschlossen. Werkstatt-Chef Thomas Lundt persönlich übernimmt die erste Probefahrt. Leistungsstark und tiefergelegt präsentiert sich auch der top überholte T1 von Tom's Garage. In Hamburg prüft Blechroller-Profi Helge, ob die Vespa-Silberpfeil straßentauglich ist. Fummelig geht’s heute bei den Minis Hamburg zu. Die restaurierte Tür muss wieder in den Wagen.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Neues Projekt, viel Arbeit. Werkstatt-Chef Thomas Lundt hat einen alten Porsche angeschleppt. Den Flying Classics aus Hamburg haben es Kultmopeds angetan. Besonders beliebt, die Ost-Marke Simson. In Tom's Roadhouse wird heute eine antike Vorkriegs-Limousine begutachtet: ein Steyr 220. Abschied bei den Minis Hamburg. Der TÜV-fertige Youngtimer wartet auf die stolze Besitzerin.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Der japanische Ausdruck "Tsunami" bedeutet übersetzt "Welle im Hafen". Große Verwerfungen am Meeresgrund lösen diese tödlichen Überschwemmungen aus. Ein starkes Beben vor der Küste Japans verursachte 2011 einen enormen Tsunami. Doch die bisher verheerendste Flutwelle brach einen Tag nach Weihnachten 2004 über Südasien herein. Die Wassermassen hinterließen ein nie dagewesenes Maß an Zerstörung.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Einige der am dichtesten besiedelten Ballungsräume der Welt liegen in Erdbebengebieten. Tektonische Verwerfungen im Untergrund sind immer wieder seismisch aktiv - und tödlich. Mexico City erlebte auf den Tag genau 32 Jahre nach einem Megabeben eine erneute gewaltige Erschütterung. Erdbeben gehören zu den furchterregendsten Zerstörungskräften, die die Natur bereithält.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Sintflutartiger Regen, machtvoller Wind und riesige Wellen kennzeichnen die großen Wirbelstürme, die auf dem Meer entstehen. Der Hurrikan "Katrina" ging 2005 in die Geschichte ein: Als der Wirbelsturm an der Golfküste der USA auf Land traf, löste er eine traumatische Katastrophe aus. Hurrikan "Maria" zeigte 2017 auf Puerto Rico, welch unbarmherzige Gewalt die Natur entfesseln kann.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Tornados sind ein außergewöhnliches Phänomen. In den rotierenden Säulen aus Luft kann der Wind Geschwindigkeiten von mehr als 480 Kilometern pro Stunde erreichen. Tornados wurden schon auf fast allen Kontinenten beobachtet, aber eine Region ist besonders betroffen: Die "Tornado Alley" in den USA verzeichnet Jahr für Jahr ungewöhnlich viele Tornados der verheerendsten Kategorie.

programme.desc: Lexion 780 ist einer der modernsten und leistungsstärksten Mähdrescher der Welt.

programme.desc: Er ist der König des unwegsamen Geländes, der Schreitbagger M545x.

programme.desc: Wo gewöhnliche Zugmaschinen versagen, muss die Firma Titan ran.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Unter Tage sind die bulldoggenähnlichen Maschinen von GHH gefragt.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Bei der Hyperloop-Technologie werden magnetisch angetriebene Transportkapseln durch eine Vakuum-Röhre befördert. Der dadurch wegfallende Luftwiderstand ermöglicht sehr hohe Geschwindigkeiten und nahezu geräuschloses Reisen. Doch von den ersten Pilotprojekten hin zum flächendeckenden Einsatz ist es noch ein weiter Weg.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Schwebten 2010 noch weniger als 900 aktive Satelliten im Weltraum, so sind es heute fast 5000, und viele davon sind nur so groß wie ein Schuhkarton. Sogenannte "Satellitenschwärme" können uns mit wichtigen Daten versorgen - doch welche Gefahren bringen sie mit sich? Und wer wird den Kampf um die Vorherrschaft im All gewinnen?

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Auf der ganzen Welt zerbrechen sich Ingenieure und Wissenschaftler die Köpfe, um ein zentrales Problem zu lösen: Wie kann man Strom sicher und effizient in großem Maßstab und zu geringen Kosten speichern? Die Suche nach Antworten bringt einige wirklich bemerkenswerte Ideen hervor. Doch welche davon funktionieren auch in der Praxis?

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Das Baugewerbe ist für einen erschreckend hohen Prozentsatz des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs und der Treibhausgasemissionen verantwortlich und aktuell ist keine Trendwende in Sicht. Wie können wir in Zukunft umweltfreundlicher bauen und wohnen? Und welche Rolle könnten dabei Gebäude aus Holz spielen?

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein missglückter Versuch, eine Plastiktapete herzustellen, führt zur Erfindung von Luftpolsterfolie. Die Vorstufe eines Mittels zur Blutstillung wird zur Partydroge MDMA, auch bekannt als Ecstasy. Ein Missgeschick im Labor führt zur Entdeckung von Schießbaumwolle. Und ein defektes Satellitenobjektiv verbessert die Brustkrebsvorsorge.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Klebeband spielt eine Rolle bei bedeutendsten Entdeckungen in der Materialwissenschaft des 21. Jahrhunderts. Ein Fehler bei der Herstellung von Bonbons erschafft ein erfolgreiches Abführmittel. Ein wenig erfolgreicher Sekundenkleber beschert uns Post-it-Klebezettel. Und ein Spaziergang im Schnee führt beinahe zum nuklearen Armageddon.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Ein Metall, das eigentlich für Gewehrläufe entwickelt wurde, ist schon bald aus keiner Küche mehr wegzudenken: rostfreier Stahl. Ein Sack Erde von einer abgelegenen Insel enthält ein Bakterium, das die Alterung aufhält. Und das Entfernen von Kletten aus dem Fell eines Hundes führt zur Erfindung des Klettverschlusses.

programme.title: Geniale Zufälle
programme.desc: Auf der Suche nach einer künstlichen Form von Chinin entsteht zufällig der erste künstliche Farbstoff, Mauvein. Ein gescheitertes Reinigungsmittel führt zur Erfindung von Frischhaltefolie. Bei einem Versuch, Bakterien im Labor zu züchten, wird ein Krebsmedikament entdeckt. Und Krankenschwestern an der Westfront erfinden die Damenbinde.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In einer Hamburger Werft liegt eine Hafenfähre zur Modernisierung. Das Schiff wurde dafür komplett entkernt. Ein halbes Jahr soll die Fähre in der Werft bleiben, dann soll sie wieder auf die Elbe. Schiffsbauer Melvin Ommer und Torben Groth bauen die generalüberholte Antriebsmaschine wieder ein. Gar nicht so einfach, denn das riesige Bauteil wiegt 1,5 Tonnen, und der Maschinenraum ist eng.

Alvin plans to pull the curtain back on his boss, but has to watch his toes going against Victoria.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: A BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS e Porsche Cayenne Turbo estão entre os SUVs mais fortes e rápidos do mundo. Os veículos utilitários esportivos fabricados na Alemanha são a encarnação da perfeição técnica, desempenho superior e conforto único. Na estrada, eles se sentem como um carro esportivo e ao mesmo tempo são capazes de dominar cada obstáculo em terreno aberto como um off-roader. A DreamCars apresenta os utilitários esportivos alemães mais caros, exclusivos e rápidos.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxo, estilo de vida e exclusividade, nenhum outro carro transporta estes atributos melhor que os SUVs da Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo e Infinity. Seja a elegância britânica, o design sueco moderno e reduzido ou o visual japonês esportivo, estes SUVs elegantes e excelentemente equipados incorporam um espírito de aventura e um gosto pela vida. A DreamCars apresenta os SUVs mais caros e exclusivos do mundo como o Bentley Bentayga, o Volvo XC90 ou o Infinity QX70.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Eles representam o estilo de vida americano mais do que qualquer outro carro, utilitários esportivos americanos e caminhonetes. Eles são extremamente grandes, extremamente poderosos e extremamente luxuosos e transportam a sensação de possibilidades ilimitadas e de aventura. Seja o Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor ou Dodge Ram, a DreamCars apresenta os mais espetaculares e mais potentes SUVs e caminhonetes americanas.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: O Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 tem suas origens no exército japonês. Sua forma não ganhará nenhum concurso de beleza nem alcançará os melhores resultados no túnel de vento, mas este não é realmente o ponto com um SUV como este.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S - Novas Formas
programme.desc: Desde que a Aston Martin se tornou o carro da empresa de James Bond, a marca tem alcançado o estatuto de culto. Mas a venerável marca britânica também não está a fugir à evolução - porque com o Rapide S, Aston Martin está a desbravar novos caminhos.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.sub-title: A historia do circuito Yas Marina
programme.desc: O circuito Yas Marina em Abu Dhabi é o circuito mais glamouroso da Fórmula 1 e Khaled Qubaysi nos leva a este olhar exclusivo nos bastidores do famoso circuito.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Stéphane Peterhansel é o piloto de maior sucesso na história do Rally Dakar. Com a equipe alemã X-Raid, ele venceu as edições de 2012 e 2013 desta prestigiosa competição em um Mini Countryman.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Há mais de um século o homem e a máquina tentam domar a montanha de Pikes Peak, onde os ousados arriscam tudo para serem os mais rápidos a chegar ao cume. Mostramos-lhe os destaques da corrida de 2018.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.sub-title: Acao sobre o gelo na Finlandia
programme.desc: O ex-campeão mundial de rally Armin Schwarz é uma lenda atrás do volante. Nós o acompanhamos em seu treinamento de motorista em um Subaru WRX STI na paisagem nevada e gelada de tirar o fôlego da Finlândia.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: O Tourist Trophy na Ilha de Man Britânica é a corrida de motocicletas mais famosa do mundo. O campeão de carros laterais TT Klaus Klaffenböck e o especialista em corridas Lenz Leberkern exploram o fascínio deste evento icônico.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: Com a Active Hybrid 7, ao contrário de sua antecessora com o mesmo nome de modelo, BMW agora conta com um híbrido completo, que também pode ser acionado exclusivamente com energia elétrica.

programme.desc: 1963, há mais de 50 anos, com o Quattroporte Maserati inventou uma nova categoria de veículos, o sedan esportivo. Este modelo GTS já é a sexta geração deste carro icônico.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Smart também ofereceu o seu icónico carro citadino com opção de descapotável. O Mini cabriolet é maior, não apenas debaixo do capô. Oferece espaço para quatro pessoas. Quando se trata de uma grande sensação de roadster, o Mazda MX-5 está no topo da lista. Demos uma vista de olhos mais atenta a estes três concorrentes de topo aberto.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: O Salão Automobilístico de Paris é o salão automobilístico mais antigo do mundo e dá uma visão do mundo automotivo. Em 2016, a Mercedes apresentou sua sub-marca "Generation EQ", e a Volkswagen anunciou a construção de 20 novos modelos eletrificados.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Para alguns, a forma de cupê tem um apelo mais sexy, mas por que alguém escolhe um cupê de duas portas como o Mercedes E400 em vez do CLS com quatro portas? Além disso: independentemente do preço diferente, a Volkswagen Arteon ainda desafia o CLS.

programme.title: Incrível Jaguar F-Type R Tuning: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: Um Jaguar que pode atacar o medo no mundo apenas com o seu rugido. Este Jaguar Arden-tuned F-Type R é um verdadeiro mau rapaz. Já tem uma verdadeira dentada na configuração padrão, mas o Arden é mais forte, mais alto e mais agressivo.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: Parece mais esportivo do que se poderia esperar dos suecos. Os faróis traseiros emolduram a poderosa parte traseira. No interior, o Volvo S90 impressiona com os materiais mais finos e o couro macio da napa.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Nem sempre é a pura potência de um carro que torna a condução através das curvas excitante. O Subaru BRZ com seu motor de boxer baixo e seu manuseio bem equilibrado dá ao seu motorista uma sensação muito boa para a estrada. O BMW 235i RS tem um ótimo desempenho na roda traseira e o Porsche Cayman GTS com seu motor médio coloca um sorriso no seu rosto assim que você coloca o pé no acelerador.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Com a criação de sua i8, a BMW, fabricante de automóveis sediada em Munique, dá um grande passo em direção ao futuro. Afinal, o carro de aparência futurista é o primeiro carro esportivo alemão que utiliza tecnologia híbrida. Os supercarros checam o BMW i8 nas ruas de Los Angeles. Mas a BMW não trabalhou apenas no i8. Eles também apresentam o novo coupé esportivo 435i e o esportivo SUV X550d M.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Se você só se sentou no fundo de uma grande limusine e não sabe o quanto este tipo de limusine é, você provavelmente faz parte da administração. Quando se trata de experiência de condução e desempenho, faz sentido que o assento do motorista seja menos atraente. Mas esse é apenas o caso de carros estaduais experientes de qualquer forma. O Audi RS e Mercedes S-Class podem até mesmo fazer com que alguns motoristas fiquem desempregados.

programme.title: A bordo da McLaren 570 GT

programme.title: 4x4

Visualmente, poderia ser modelado após o Discovery, cuja quinta geração é uma mistura de veículo todo-o-terreno e SUV de luxo. Também: o SsangYong Rexton, o Jeep Renegade e a nossa escolha dos 5 melhores veículos todo-o-terreno.

Também: o ágil e confiável Skoda Octavia Combi. E: o Jaguar XF Sportbrake, um vagão de estação para individualistas.

Qual destas motorizadas 4x4 tem melhor preço em terrenos difíceis e ainda oferece adequação suficiente para o uso diário?

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 152: Sue os, celos y un despido cruel
programme.desc: Al haberse convertido por primera vez en padre Lu s Fernando se deja aconsejar por R mulo quien le insiste en las responsabilidades y alegr as que esta a punto de experimentar ahora que es padre, situaci n que tiene que afrontar de por vida. Al vivir una experiencia distinta a la de Lu s Fernando Dileidy se deja abatir por la tristeza de saberlo perdido para siempre en vista de ahora Lu s Fernando contar con una familia conformada por su esposa M Gracia y su reci n nacido bebe y asumir la idea de que se convirti en un hombre imposible para ella, Gladys se burla de la vocaci n de santa de Dileidy al saberla sufriendo por gusto por un hombre que bajo su perspectiva nunca ser para ella tras saber a Lu s Fernando comprometido con su nueva familia. Dileidy se tortura sonando con Lu s Fernando al ocupar ella en su sue o el puesto de M Gracia como su esposa y la madre de su hijo, Lu s Fernando se une a Dileidy en su sue o al imagin rsela como su esposa y madre de su hijo para despertar y caer en cuenta de que no todo es perfecto como lo so ado por ambos. Betzaida se ve victima de una depresi n post parto tomando su incontrolable tristeza en contra de R mulo y su pasada relaci n con Egl e al creer a la madura madre de los hijos de R mulo una mujer perfecta y sentirse celosa y envidiosa del estado que Egl e despierta en R mulo, R mulo se compromete ante su esposa Betzaida y su reci n nacida a ser un mejor padre del que fue con sus hijos y a no cometer con ellos los mismos errores cometidos en contra de primera familia. Al sentirse inspirado por las an cdotas de su pasado matrimonio con R mulo, Santiago hace planes de iniciar una familia con Egl e comprometi ndose a no cometer los errores de desagradecimiento de su ex esposo. Al estar percatada de la molestia de Gladys por tener que ir a servir a la casa de la Nena y de su posible encuentro con el padre de Gerson Dileidy le sugiere a su madre que renuncie a su empleo, Gladys por su parte se reserva las ganas de informar a Paco de la verdad acerca de su paternidad sobre Gerson esperando as que el d a que le de la noticia este caiga muerto de la sorpresa. A pesar de no recordar a Gladys como parte de su pasado Paco se tortura y atormenta con la mujer a quien le prodiga una profunda animadversi n. A la ma ana siguiente Paco sinti ndose harto de la presencia de Gladys en su casa planifica para ella un cruel despido al sembrar en su esposa la Nena la duda acerca de la honradez de Gladys, Tatiana alienta la versi n de Paco acerca del robo de Gladys al recordar junto a su familia ocasiones de desaparici n de cosas en la casa de Egl e, M Antonia a pesar del frente unido formado por Paco y Tatiana en contra de Gladys defiende a la mujer que la ha acompa ado en sus a os de soledad al saberla incapaz de robar. Al comentar con Dileidy su situaci n al tener un hijo del esposo de su patrona la Nena Gladys sin saberlo orienta a Gerson hacia la verdad del responsable de su paternidad. M Antonia al sentirse preocupada y desorientada acerca de que hacer con Gladys consulta entre sus amigas para tomar una decisi n con respecto a su empleada y confidente. Matilde se compromete a guarda fidelidad ante Gladys al desatender los rumores que giran en su contra. Gavito descubre a remedios entrometi ndose en sus asuntos al sorprenderla con su libreta de an cdotas en la mano. En la cl nica como madre primeriza M Gracia se deja agobiar por las dudas que tiene con respecto a su bebe, Egl e llega al lugar para ayudarlos en su traslado con el bebe a la casa. Entre tanto en la empresa de ingenier a Dileidy se mantiene al pendiente de la llegada de Lu s Fernando a pesar de saber que esto es imposible por encontrarse el estren ndose como padre. Yenil conversa con Dileidy para informar a su amiga de la consumaci n de su aventura con Gonzalo tras haber aceptado su propuesta de ir a un hotel, entre tanto Gonzalo hace lo mismo al informar a Moncho de su aventura extramarital con Yenil . Matilde utiliza a Moncho como su pa o de lagrimas mientras se muestra harta de su matrimonio con Gonzalo d ndole as esperanzas a Moncho de una posible relaci n amorosa entre ambos al incluso mostrarse dispuesta a divorciarse. A su regreso a la casa Egl e se comporta como la perfecta abuela al aconsejara M Gracia sobre el cuidado y el amamantamiento que debe seguir con su bebe, entre tanto en la casa de Betzaida R mulo se encarga por completo del cuidado de su reci n nacida hija al percatarse del cansancio de Betzaida. Egl e se atormenta con la idea de sufrir el abandono de su ex esposo R mulo ahora que este comenz una nueva familia.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 97: Explosi n en el aeropuerto y ceguera de Daniela
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo va al aeropuerto a despedir a Doris y Betania. Cuando llega Berta le dice que ya es tarde, ya que ellas est n saliendo. Luis Guillermo ve la avioneta como sube y al instante explota. Se tira al suelo y comienza a llorar llamando a Betania. Cuando voltea ve a Betania que viene corriendo hacia l. Berta se va de inmediato del aeropuerto, ya que est aterrada por lo que ella autoriz a que pasara. Ya que la falla exist a y ella oblig al capit n a arrancar. Robert mientras tanto est en el hospital oyendo la noticia de que Daniela est ciega. Daniela se pone a gritar y a preguntar tambi n por Luis Guillermo. Berta llama por tel fono a Robert y le informa de lo que pas .

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Episodio 21
programme.desc: Leo organiza una fiesta con Jorge en un apartamento que le presta Rodrigo, y debido a la falta de las autorizaciones necesarias para la fiesta, terminan todos detenidos. Julio llama a Irene para pedirle ayuda, quien descubre que su hermana, Lucía, también estaba detenida. Irene logra que los liberen con el abogado Felipe, bajo la condición de que hagan servicio comunitario. Trinidad, la madre de Lucía e Irene, se enfurece al saber que Lucía estaba con los jóvenes Ferrándiz. Por otro lado, Carlos Ernesto discute con su madre, Jimena, por entrometerse en sus asuntos. Luego, sale a almorzar con una misteriosa mujer. Rodrigo le confiesa a Alejandra que tiene información sobre el asesinato de Miguel Ferrándiz y que la revelará cuando sea conveniente para ambos.

programme.title: Episodio 109: Salvador conoce a la peque a Coquita.
programme.desc: Salvador insiste en preguntar si el beb que llora es el peque o Salvador, pero Socorro cuelga. Mar a le dice que todos los beb s lloran muy parecido, pero seg n Salvador sabe que se trataba del llanto del beb de Socorro.Julio C sar escribe una carta amenazante a Salvador.Salvador sale de la cl nica y al primer lugar que va es a la iglesia. All habla con el padre y conoce a una peque a ni a de la calle que se llama Socorro, pero le dicen Coquita. Salvador le dice a Coquita que no va a volver a pelear y Coquita le responde que la decepcion porque pensaba que era de los que nunca se daban por vencidos. Coquita le cuenta a Salvador que vive sola y en la calle porque no tiene familia. Salvador se lleva a Coquita a dormir esa noche a su casa.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le propone a Irene nuevamente que se case con ella, Irene acepta pero le pone ciertas condiciones, una de ellas son los papeles de la separación de bienes. Carlos se reencuentra con Altaír, la esposa de Juan Pablo, su ex amante. Mas logo depois que eles embarcam em sua jornada inaugural, eventos estranhos e assustadores começam a aterrorizar David e sua família, fazendo com que se voltem um contra o outro e duvidem de sua própria sanidade.

programme.title: Do Outro Lado do Corredor

Hospedado no mesmo hotel em que ela está com o amante, Terry liga para o amigo Julian (Mike Vogel), que tentará impedir que Terry cometa um crime.

programme.desc: Alice Launey, uma especialista forense francesa ainda assombrada por seu passado, vem a Seul para apresentar seu trabalho. Ela conhecerá JinHo, um detetive que pede sua ajuda em um caso de assassinato. Atraída pela rede do tráfico, ela precisa enfrentar seus medos.

programme.title: La Hermana Buena
programme.desc: Fontayne es reclutada por Bernice (su vieja amiga distanciada y actual oficial de libertad condicional) junto con un policía deshonrado para buscar al hijo de Bernice, que desapareció en la frontera con México.

programme.title: A Hora do Acerto
programme.desc: Para a Gangue dos 5, tudo é um videogame: matar policiais, armar emboscadas e criar requintes de crueldade. Quem se torna vítima de suas armadilhas é o inspetor de polícia Wing e todo o seu time de policiais, que são brutalmente assassinados. Após a matança, um jovem novato cheio de energia é designado para ajudálo, mas a Gangue dos 5 volta a agir, iniciando uma aventura cheia de ação e vingança.

programme.title: Secretos Peligrosos
programme.desc: Un drama basado en las experiencias de Kathryn Bolkovac, una policía de Nebraska que sirvió como fuerza de paz en la Bosnia de posguerra y denunció a la ONU por encubrir un escándalo de tráfico sexual.

programme.title: Olhos de Dragão
programme.desc: Em St. Jude, traficantes de drogas e policiais corruptos destruíram um bairro urbano. Mas o recém-chegado Hong possui as habilidades de luta e a visão moral necessárias para salvar esta cidade de si mesma.

programme.title: O Dono do Jogo
programme.desc: A história dos preparativos para o lendário confronto pelo campeonato mundial entre Bobby Fischer, o campeão americano de xadrez, e o campeão soviético Boris Spassky. O duelo, que ocorreu em 1972, no auge da Guerra Fria, foi muito mais do que apenas uma série de partidas para conquistar um campeonato.

programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

programme.title: Laços de um Crime
programme.desc: Quando a polícia descobre uma jovem brutalmente assassinada, os irmãos Joe Fairburn (Paul Bettany) e Chrissie Fairburn se juntam ao seu supervisor, Robert (Mark Strong), para investigar o principal suspeito: Jason Buliegh, um criminoso sexual. Forçados a liberar Jason da custódia da polícia, os Fairburns tomam o assunto em suas próprias mãos; sufocados pela sombra de seu pai.

programme.title: Castigo Del Cielo
programme.desc: El exitoso abogado neoyorquino Sam Leibowitz viaja al sur en 1933 para defender a nueve jóvenes negros acusados de violar a dos mujeres en un tren de carga de Alabama. En la primavera de 1931, nueve vagabundos negros fueron bajados de un tren de carga de Alabama y arrestados por presuntamente violar a dos jóvenes blancas en un vagón de góndola.

programme.title: Massacre no Bairro Chinês
programme.desc: Jackie Chan faz o papel de um fugitivo do Japão que se torna um assassino para a máfia. O longa é focado na vida de imigrantes chineses que vivem no Japão.

programme.title: O Último Guarda-Costas
programme.desc: Após ser libertado da prisão, um criminoso do sul de Londres tenta esquecer seu passado e mudar de vida; ele então se torna o protetor de uma jovem atriz que enfrenta alguns problemas.

programme.title: A Recompensa
programme.desc: Depois de passar 12 anos na prisão, um famoso ladrão está de volta para receber o que lhe é devido.

programme.desc: Duas mulheres de origens diferentes começam uma relação na década de 1950. Carol é casada, mas seu casamento está morto há muito tempo. Ela quer um divórcio, mas o marido está tentando desesperadamente manter as aparências. Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. Seu marido tenta usar a homosexualidade de Carol no tribunal contra ela e lhe proíbe de ver sua filha por pelo menos 3 meses em uma tentativa de vingança

programme.desc: Um professor universitário alcoólatra em recuperação conhece uma nova aluna sedutora. Ela oferece a ele uma fuga sensual da realidade até que ele perceba que ela pode ser louca.

Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

No inicio, Lucile tenta ignorar Bruno, o refinado oficial alemão que estava com elas, mas depois, um amor forte atrai-los e leva-os a tragédia da guerra.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
